title.narrative: Support for the UN OCHA Pooled Fund Management Branch (PFMB)

description.narrative: UNOPS Supports the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) Pooled Fund Management Branch (PFMB)/Financing and Partnerships Division(FPD) in implementing the OCHA 2023-2026 Strategic Plan. This also includes bolstering the implementation of the newly introduced OCHA Communications Strategy 2024-2026 and the Partnership and Resource Mobilization Strategy 2023-2026. OCHA-managed Pooled Funds play a crucial role in enabling OCHA to deliver on its mandate and directly support the humanitarian community in responding to the needs of the most at-risk and marginalized people.\n
